title: Under Frequency the website's What's happening panels show a live map of where things meet, and every map wears the Frequency palette day and night

source.ref: Daniel 2026-10-14: frequencylocal.com/the-community#near shows an empty map panel (rings only); make Google Maps work site wide with the design system's styles.

detail: Cause: WhatsOnList, the coded port of the design's eventmap.js, rendered only the placeholder rings and never mounted a map, because public events carry a city and no coordinate. Fix: one approximate pin per city at its centroid (lib/maps/city-centroids.ts, moved out of lib/discover.ts), rendered through MapCanvas (Google with the browsable key, MapLibre without), mounted only when the pane nears the viewport and never when the kit hides it (phones, chapter splits), so no hidden pane bills a Google load. Basemap: lib/maps/basemap-look.ts reads the --fq-* tokens at the map's container (so Stage, UV night and Thermal night each paint their own ground), feeds Google a JSON styles array when no Cloud Map ID is set, and puts the design's dark tile filter on the MapLibre canvas only. DAWN has no --fq-* tokens and renders unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const parts=r('components/frequency/site/pages/shared/parts.tsx'),map=r('components/frequency/site/pages/shared/whats-on-map.tsx'),g=r('components/maps/google-canvas.tsx'),m=r('components/maps/maplibre-canvas.tsx'),look=r('lib/maps/basemap-look.ts');const bad=[];if(!/<WhatsOnMap pins=/.test(parts))bad.push('the website map panel mounts no map');if(!/<MapCanvas/.test(map))bad.push('the website map does not render through the map seam');if(!/IntersectionObserver/.test(map))bad.push('the website map is not lazy');if(!/styles: googleMapStyles\(palette\)/.test(g))bad.push('Google maps ignore the design palette');if(!/maplibreTileFilter\(palette\)/.test(m))bad.push('MapLibre maps ignore the design palette');if(!/--fq-bg-canvas/.test(look))bad.push('the basemap does not read the Frequency tokens');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-927: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
